items.name: Movie Recommendation System
points: Content-based recommender using TF-IDF vectors and cosine similarity on movie metadata.
FastAPI backend for model inference, with similarity matrices serialized as .pkl files.
Streamlit interface with TMDB API integration for real-time recommendations.

items.name: Demand Forecasting App
points: Predicts product demand from price, discount, inventory, promotion, competitor pricing and category.
Preprocessing, categorical encoding and feature preparation before modelling.
Streamlit app serving a trained XGBoost model for instant predictions.

items.name: Student Result Predictor
points: Predicts student results based on attendance, assignment scores, and exam performance.
Data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training using scikit-learn.
Implemented a user-friendly interface for inputting student data and receiving predictions.

items.name: E-commerce Data Analysis & Dashboard
points: Exploratory analysis of sales patterns, trends and business insights.
Cleaned and transformed datasets with Python and Pandas.
Built data visualizations and an interactive dashboard.

items.name: Customer Service Analytics Dashboard
points: Interactive Power BI report (.pbix) analyzing customer service data.
Built on an Excel dataset, with the report file and data published in the repository.

items.name: Screen Time Tracker App
points: Screen time tracking application built around a Python script (App.py).
Stores usage data in a local database file and ships with its own icon set.

items.name: Cyber Attacks on V2V Communication
points: B.Sc. thesis and IEEE paper studying cyber-attacks on vehicle-to-vehicle networks.
Second IEEE paper evaluates spectrum sliced-FSO systems with different modulation schemes.

items.name: Spectrum Sliced-FSO Systems
points: Second IEEE paper evaluates spectrum sliced-FSO systems with different modulation schemes.
Analyzed performance metrics like bit error rate, signal-to-noise ratio, and data throughput.

items.name: RM22: IoT Research & Educational Robot
points: Team build of a mobile robot platform on ESP8266 (NodeMCU) with dual DC motors and a motor driver.
Wi-Fi remote control, motor direction and speed control, and power distribution.

items.name: Mars Rover Prototype
points: Designed and developed a rover prototype with a university team.
Applied robotics concepts, system integration and collaborative problem-solving.
